Splash,Ⓒv.ⒹAsPal c., (AsPAlitaM yatpramadA-karAgrEH R. xvi. 13), krIqAyAM taq 10; ita-stataH vikzip 6 P.
Ⓝ[Splash]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹAsPAlanaM, vikzepaH, AsPAlanaSabdaH-nAdaH; ‘the log fell down with a s(plashing)’ kAzWaKaMqaH patito jalamA-sPAlayat.

Spleen,Ⓒs.ⒹplIhan m.; plIhA, gulmaH; ‘enlargement of the s(pleen)’ plIhABivfdDi f., plIho-daraM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMraMBaH, manyuH; ‘s(pleen)-wort’ plIhaGnaH, plIhaSatruH.
ⓃSplenetic,Ⓒa.ⒹplIharogin.
Ⓑ
 2 vakra-karkaSa-SIla, piSuna, karkaSa.

Splendid,Ⓒa.ⒹBAsura; ujjvala, BAsvat, atitEjasa (sI f.), atiSoBana, supraBa, atipraBa, atidIptimat; mahAtejas; ‘a s(plendid) dress’ ujjvalaveSaH, udAranepaTyaM.
Ⓑ
 2 SrezWa, praSasya, parama, viSizwatama, aBinaMdya, (success).
Ⓑ
 3 mahApratApa, pratApavat; See Majestic.
Ⓝ[Splendid]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹujjvalaM, supraBaM, atiSoBayA, atipratApena; ‘s(plendidly) dressed’ ujjvalaveSaDArin
ⓃSplendour,Ⓒs.ⒹSoBA, tejas n., SrIH, praBA, OjjvalyaM, BAsuratvaM, ati-SoBA-kAMti-dIpti f., mahAtejaH, pratApaH, viBUti f., vEBavaM.

Splint, [Splint]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(kAzWa-)KaMqaH, SakalaM, vidalaM, BinnaM.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓvi-dF 9 P or c.; See Tear.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓvi-dal 1 P, sPuw 6 P, viBid pass.

Split,Ⓒv. i.ⒹsPuw 6 P, vi-, dal 1 P, BaMj-viBid-vidF- pass., truw 4, 6 P, SakalIBU 1 P.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹsPuw c., vi-, dF 9 P or c., vi-, paw 10, vi-, Bid 7 P or c., Baj 7 P, KaMq 10, vi-, Cid 7 P, truw c., vidal c. (dalayati), SakalIkf 8 U.
Ⓔs.Ⓓvi-, BedaH, BaMgaH, vidaraH, sPu(sPo)wanaM; [] BidA, CidraM, raMDraM.
Ⓝ[Split]ting,Ⓒs.ⒹvidAraRaM, vipA-wanaM, vidalanaM, &c.
